# tdarr-exporter

![Version: 2.2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-2.2.0-informational?style=flat-square) ![Type: application](https://img.shields.io/badge/Type-application-informational?style=flat-square) ![AppVersion: 3.0.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/AppVersion-3.0.0-informational?style=flat-square) ![Kubernetes: >=1.19.0-0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kubernetes-%3E%3D1.19.0--0-informational?style=flat-square)

A Helm chart to export Prometheus metrics for Tdarr.

Based on the [`homeylab/tdarr-exporter`](https://github.com/homeylab/tdarr-exporter) image.

This chart is also included as an optional deployment in the [exportarr](https://github.com/homeylab/helm-charts/tree/main/charts/exportarr) helm chart. You can use the `exportarr` chart and set `tdarr-exporter.enabled` if you prefer having all your `Arr` related exporters in one chart.

## Add Chart Repo
```bash
helm repo add homeylab https://homeylab.github.io/helm-charts/
# update the chart, this can also be run to pull new versions of the chart for upgrades
helm repo update homeylab
```

## Prerequisites
Point the exporter at a reachable Tdarr instance. Set `settings.config.url` (e.g. `https://tdarr.example.org:8265`) — **required**. If no protocol is provided, the exporter defaults to `https`.

Authentication is optional. Set `settings.config.apiKey` for the Tdarr API key, or provide `settings.config.existingSecret` (`{name, secretKey}`) to reference an existing secret instead — `existingSecret` takes precedence over `apiKey`. If neither is set, the exporter connects unauthenticated.

## Install
```bash
helm install tdarr-exporter homeylab/tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter --create-namespace

# with own values file - recommended
helm install -f my-values.yaml tdarr-exporter homeylab/tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter --create-namespace
```

### OCI Registry Support
```bash
helm install tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter oci://registry-1.docker.io/homeylabcharts/tdarr-exporter --version X.Y.Z --create-namespace

# with own values file - recommended
helm install -f my-values.yaml tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter oci://registry-1.docker.io/homeylabcharts/tdarr-exporter --version X.Y.Z --create-namespace
```

### Install Example
Only some options are shown, view `values.yaml` for an exhaustive list.

<details closed>
<summary>custom-values.yaml</summary>
<br>

```yaml
# custom-values.yaml
settings:
  config:
    url: "https://tdarr.example.org:8265"
    apiKey: "fakeapikey"

metrics:
  enabled: true
  serviceMonitor:
    enabled: true
  ## Optional alerting rules (requires the Prometheus Operator CRD)
  # prometheusRule:
  #   enabled: true
  #   ## labels your Prometheus ruleSelector matches on
  #   labels:
  #     release: kube-prometheus-stack
  #   rules:
  #     - alert: TdarrExporterTargetDown
  #       annotations:
  #         summary: tdarr-exporter metrics endpoint is down.
  #       expr: up{job=~".*tdarr-exporter.*"} == 0
  #       for: 5m
  #       labels:
  #         severity: warning

## Alternative to ingress - Gateway API HTTPRoute (chart does NOT create the Gateway)
# httproute:
#   enabled: true
#   parentRefs:
#     - name: my-gateway
#       namespace: gateway-system
#   hostnames:
#     - tdarr-exporter.example.org
```
</details>
<br>

## Upgrade
```bash
helm upgrade tdarr-exporter homeylab/tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter

# with own values file - recommended
helm upgrade -f my-values.yaml tdarr-exporter homeylab/tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter
```

### OCI Registry Support
```bash
helm upgrade tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter oci://registry-1.docker.io/homeylabcharts/tdarr-exporter --version X.Y.Z

# with own values file - recommended
helm upgrade -f my-values.yaml tdarr-exporter -n tdarr-exporter oci://registry-1.docker.io/homeylabcharts/tdarr-exporter --version X.Y.Z
```

### Breaking Changes

| Start Chart Version | Target Chart Version | Upgrade Steps |
| ------------------- | -------------------- | ------------- |
| `1.X.X` | `2.0.0` | Hardened `securityContext`, standardized image schema, chart-managed Secret for the inline API key, and `appVersion` bumped to the current upstream `v3.0.0` image. **Read the [upgrade notes](https://github.com/homeylab/helm-charts/blob/main/charts/tdarr-exporter/docs/upgrade.md#from-1xx-to-200) in full before upgrading.** |

_The [full upgrade notes](https://github.com/homeylab/helm-charts/blob/main/charts/tdarr-exporter/docs/upgrade.md) cover every version, including upgrades gated on opt-in settings._
